meta.name: proto-persona
meta.description: Create a proto-persona from current research, market signals, and team knowledge. Use when you need a working customer profile before deeper validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 基于调研和团队知识快速创建用户画像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在深入验证前快速建立客户画像
copy.tagline_en: Create a working customer profile from research and team knowledge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick customer profile before deeper validation

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的目标用户和已有信息（如支持工单、销售笔记等），生成一个假设性的用户画像草稿，包含姓名、背景、痛点、目标等，并标记出需要验证的假设。
howto.when: 当你需要快速对齐团队对目标用户的理解，但还没有深入的用户研究时触发。例如，在早期产品开发或启动新功能前。

say.text: 为采用我们发票扫描应用的独立簿记员创建一个原型人物画像。
say.note: Claude 会基于你提供的信号生成画像草稿。

say.text: 为我们的新功能目标用户——远程团队管理者——生成一个原型人物。
say.note: Claude 会询问你已知的信息并结构化输出。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a hypothesis-driven proto-persona based on your target user and available signals (e.g., support tickets, sales notes), including name, background, pains, goals, and flagged assumptions needing validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to quickly align a team on a target user profile before deep research, e.g., early product development or before a new feature kickoff.

say_en.text: Create a proto-persona for solo bookkeepers adopting our receipt-scanning app.
say_en.note: Claude will use provided signals to draft the persona.

say_en.text: Generate a proto-persona for remote team managers as our new feature target.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for known context and structure the output.
